senses.gloss:
Mercenary,Ⓒa.ⒹarTaparavaSa, lABaparAyaRa, lA-BArTin, DanalubDa, lABadfzwi-budDi, svArTapara [] svArTApekzaka; ‘from m(ercenary) motives’ lABa-dfzwyA, lABecCayA, svArTApekzayA.
Ⓑ
 2 Bftaka, vEtanika (kI f.), Bfti-BaraRya-Buj, vetanArTin.
Ⓔs.ⒹBftakaH, Bfti-BaraRya-Buj m., vEtanikaH, vetanArTin m.
Ⓝ[Mercenari]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹlABadfzwyA, lABApe-kzayA, Bftakavat, svArTabudDyA.
Ⓝ[Mercenary]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹlABa dfzwi f. -apekzA-budDi f., DanalABaloBaH, svArTa-vetana-apekzA.

Merchant,Ⓒs.ⒹvaRij m., vARijaH, ApaRikaH, nEgamaH, sArTavAhaH, paRyAjIvaH, krayavikrayikaH, vEdehakaH, sArTikaH, vyavahArin m., vARijyo-pajIvin m. SrezWin m.; ‘m(erchant)ʼs business’; vARijyaM, vaRikkriyA; ‘m(erchant)ʼs exchange’ SrezWicatvaraM; ‘voyaging or seafaring m(erchant)’ sAMyAtrikaH, potavaRik; ‘company of m(erchant)s’ sArTaH, nigamaH.
Ⓝ[Merchant]able,Ⓒa.ⒹpaRya, paRyArha.
ⓃMerchandiseⒸs.ⒹvARijyaM, vyavahAraH, krayavikrayO (du.).
Ⓑ
 2 paRyaM, BAMqAni, paRya-dravyARi, vARijadravyaM-BAMqaM-paRyaM.
ⓃMercantile,Ⓒa.ⒹvARija (jI f.), vARijika (kI f.), vARijyasaMbaMDin.

Mercury,Ⓒs.ⒹpAradaH, capalaH, rasaH, sUtaH, pA-rataH; ‘white sublimate of m(ercury)’ rasakarpUraH; ‘sulphuret of m(ercury)’ kajjalI.
Ⓑ
 2 buDaH, rO-hiReyaH, sOmyaH.
Ⓝ[Mercuri]al,Ⓒa.ⒹpAradAtmaka, pAradamaya (yI f.), sapArada.
Ⓑ
 2 capala, laGuSarIra, sotsAha, tejasvin.
Ⓑ
 3 dravyaparAyaRa, DUrta.

Mercy,Ⓒs.ⒹdayA, kfpA, karuRA, anukaMpA, anu-kroSaH, kAruRyaM, GfRA, dayA, kfpASIlatA, dayAlutA, kzamASIlatA, dayA-kfpA-budDi f.
Ⓑ
 2 prasAdaH, anugrahaH.
Ⓑ
 3 kzamA, titikzA ‘fountain of m(ercy)’ karuRAkaraH, dayAsAgaraH; dayA-niDiH, ‘an object of m(ercy)’ kfpApAtraM-BA-janaM, anukaMpya, anugrAhya, tapasvin; ‘to show m(ercy)’ day 1 A (with gen.), anu-kaMp 1 A (with acc.), dayAM kf 8 U (with loc.); ‘m(ercy), Oh king’ kzamasva rA-jan.
Ⓝ[Merci]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹdayAlu, kfpAlu, kfpA-dayA-karuRA-SIla, karuRArdra, dayArdra, anukaMpin, sadaya, sakaruRa, sAnukroSa, kzamASIla; vatsala, dayAbudDi-dfzwi; See Kind.
Ⓝ[Merci]fully,Ⓒadv.ⒹsadayaM, sakaruRaM, sAnukaMpaM, dayayA, karuRayA, sAnukroSaM.
Ⓝ[Merci]fulness,Ⓒs.ⒹdayA, kfpA, GfRA, dayASIlatA, anukaMpA, vAtsalyaM; See (s.).
Ⓝ[Merci]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓnirdaya, nizkaruRa, nirGfRa, akaruRa, kaWora, nizkfpa, nizWura, nfSaMsa.
Ⓝ[Merci]lessly,Ⓒadv.ⒹnirdayaM, nizkfpaM, nirGfRaM, nizWuraM.

Mere,Ⓒa.Ⓓkevala, SudDa; gen. ex. by eva, or mAtra in comp.; ‘by m(ere) touch’ sparSamA-treRa; ‘a m(ere) fool’ mUrKa eva, kevalamUrKaH.
Ⓔs.Ⓓsaras n., hradaH; See Lake.
Ⓑ
 2 paryaMtaH, sImA; See Boundary.
Ⓝ[Mere]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹkevalaM, eva, mAtra in comp.; ‘by m(erely) advising’ upadeSa-mAtrAt, upadeSAdeva, &c.

Meretricious,Ⓒa.ⒹkftrimaSoBAmaya (yI f.), bAhyarucira, kftrimarAgavat, miTyASoBana.
Ⓑ
 2 paRyAMganIya, veSyAsaMbaMDin.
Ⓝ[Meretricious]ly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓmi-TyASoBayA.

Merge,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓni-, masj 6 P, avagAh 1 A (lit); nipAgras- pass., pra-vi-lI 4 A, vi-lup pass., naS 4 P, (fig.); ‘one fault m(erge)s in a collection of good qualities’ eko hi dozA guRasannipAte nimajjati (K. i. 3).
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓmasj c., (majjayati), avagAh c.
Ⓑ
 2 naS c., vi-lup 6 P or c., gras 1 A, ni-pA 1 P, pra-vi-lI c.
ⓃMersion,Ⓒs.ⒹmajjanaM, avagAhaH-hanaM.

Meridian,Ⓒs.ⒹmaDyAhnaH, dinamaDyaM, maDyAhna-kAlaH-samayaH.
Ⓑ
 2 KamaDyaM; ‘distance from the first m(eridian)’ reKAMtaraM; ‘the sun is on the m(eridian)’ naBaso maDyamalaMkaroti BAnuH.
Ⓑ
 3 parA kowiH-kAzWA, utkarzaH.
Ⓔa.ⒹmADyAhnika (kI f.).
Ⓑ
 2 KamaDyasaMbaMDin.
Ⓑ
 3 uttama, parama; oft. ex. by parA kowiH, parA kAzWA.

Merit,Ⓒs.ⒹguRaH, yogyatA, pAtratA, utkarzaH, SrezWatA, viSizwatA, viSezaH, guRotkarzaH, guRa-vattA.
Ⓑ
 2 (‘M(erit)s’) guRAguRO, guRadozO, DarmA-DarmO.
Ⓑ
 3 puRyaM, DarmaH, sukftaM, Sreyas n., vfzaH; ‘acquired by m(erit)’ puRyArjita; ‘efficacy of m(erit)’ puRyapratApaH-praBAvaH; ‘one possessing many m(erit)s’ puRyaniDiH-rASiH-sAgaraH, puRyA-tmA.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓarh 1 P, arh-yogya- in comp.; See Deserve; ‘m(erit)ing censure’ niMdya, garha-RIya, niMdApAtraM.
Ⓝ[Merit]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓyukta, ucita, yogya; See Proper.
ⓃMeritorious,Ⓒa.ⒹpraSasya, SlAGya, praSasta, SlAGArha, praSaMsArha.
Ⓑ
 2 guRin, guRavat, guRasaMpanna, guRopeta, guRAnvita.
Ⓑ
 3 puRyavat, puRyaSIla, puRyAtman, puRyAtmaka, puRyaSAlin; puRya, puRyarUpa, avadAta (deed); ‘a m(eritorious) deed’ puRyaM, DarmaH, sukftaM, avadAtaM karma.
Ⓝ[Meritorious]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹSlAGyatayA, praSasyaM.
Ⓝ[Meritorious]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹguRavattA, pAtratA, yogyatA, &c.

Merry,Ⓒa.Ⓓpra-, hfzwa, sAnaMda, sollAsa, protPulla, pramudita, prahfzwacitta; AnaMda-ullAsa-hAsya-vftti, prasannavadana, vilAsin, vinodin, parihAsaSIla.
Ⓑ
 2 hAsyakara (rI f.), vino-daka; ‘to make m(erry)’ utsavaM kf 8 U; ‘to be m(erry)’ ullas 1 P, mud 1 A; See Delight. ‘m(erry) andrew’ BaMqaH, vEhAsikaH, vidUzakaH. ‘m(erry)-making’ AnaMdotsavaH, utsavakaraRaM.
Ⓝ[Merri]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsaharzaM, sollAsaM, sAnaMdaM, hfzWamanasA.
Ⓝ[Merri]ment,Ⓒs.Ⓓpra-, harzaH, ullAsaH, pra-, modaH, AnaMdaH, AhlAdaH; hAsyaM, parihAsaH, utsavaH, kOtukaM, vilAsaH, vinodaH; lIlA, KelA; [] ‘what is said in m(erriment)’ hAsyavinodaH; narmAlApaH, vinodokti f.
Ⓝ[Merry]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹhfzwatA, sAnaMdatA, AnaMdavftti f.
